title: Martin's Conjecture for Definable Turing-Invariant Functions
exact_target: Under determinacy, are Turing-invariant functions eventually constant or above the identity, with the nonconstant cone-equivalence classes well-ordered and successive classes obtained by the Turing jump?

sources.citation: Antonio Nakid Cordero, Martin's Conjecture in the Enumeration Degrees (2025), Introduction, Conjecture 1.2 and following paragraph.
